version.rule: Retain original version, assign schema_version separately; never overwrite newer unknown saves

i.rule: Current scene index is authoritative for legacy; map through stable scene IDs, not current ordering alone

flags.rule: Classify plot and world flags individually; do not merge blind

player.rule: Preserve all five numeric counters, document units and bound semantics

world.rule: Split track and pressure keys; seed unmapped tracks without simulating new outcomes

routes.rule: Preserve route-specific influence separately from faction capability

institutions.rule: Preserve three NSO measures and their existing scale

rel.rule: Copy all eight v0.3 relation dimensions exactly; fill only missing new fields from documented defaults

promises.rule: Preserve IDs, status, createdAt, and text; define expiry/fulfilment semantics before migration

silas.rule: Keep four observation counters and opponent history separate from player-visible beliefs

inbox.rule: Preserve message IDs, unread flags, content and order; target v1 lacks inbox field

scheduled.rule: Preserve due-as-scene-index semantics during migration, with unique callback IDs on upgrade

history.rule: Preserve ordered choice/result/quality/debrief snapshots; no replay from choice ID alone yet

finished.rule: Recompute from scene progress only after fixture checks, preserve old ending state

meta.evidence: v0.3 version only, no save_id/rng_seed/created_at; fixed local storage key

time.evidence: v0.3 scene index i, no day, block, act, chapter clock domain

world.evidence: 6 scalar world measures, 3 coalition routes and 3 NSO metrics, lacking 11-track/10-pressure structured namespaces

player.evidence: 5 counters and global promises, lacking knowledge, staff and behavior profile

actors.evidence: 14 initialized player relationships plus Silas observation counters, no beliefs/memories/state agents

network.evidence: UI power nodes and lines are presentation-only; no persistent network nodes/edges in engine state

story.evidence: ordered 18 scenes, flags, scheduled messages/history; no conditional active-scene array or event IDs

content_runtime.evidence: no content version, seen-content IDs or RNG log; inbox requires target extension

fixtures_to_build.purpose: v02 save without routes/institutions normalizes without data loss
same input replay; three different choice histories/effects
inbox and scheduled message ID/order survive roundtrip
all final routes and promise ledger survive upgrade
non-destructive recovery/export path, not a silent reset
a future save must not be down-converted by v0.3 normalization
actor belief and source groups preserve evidence chronology
